newsitem.title: USA: Morgan sets 15-20 pct rev growth target-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Morgan sets 15-20 pct rev growth target-WSJ.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Dean Witter Discover & Co is setting revenue growth targets of 15 to 20 percent, Friday's Wall Street Journal said.

According to the newspaper, executives of the newly combined firm expect higher revenue growth from gaining a larger share of real estate investment trust, preferred stock and asset-backed securities markets.
The company plans to hire brokers at a faster rate and push for higher broker productivity.
Morgan Stanley Dean Witter also seeks to build its Discover card overseas and boost its asset-management business, the Journal said.
It is also considering growth in the 401(k) business and managing Japanese assets, should that become possible, the paper said.
